Name: Jen's Goth Wizard Furniture
Author: jenf1
Description:
[size=4][b]This mod is only available here at Nexus Mods! If you see it anywhere else, it has been uploaded without my permission and should be taken down immediately![/b][/size]

A recolor of the Wizard furniture to red and black! Optionally adds a new catalogue to Krobus' shop without replacing the existing furniture!

- This new catalogue features two new beds, a Wizard Single Bed and a Wizard Child Bed.
- However, the Cauldron in the added furniture option does not function. This is a limitation of Content Patcher itself.
- If you have PIF, the added Wizard Door can be chosen to lead to any PIF room.

If you choose not to install MMAP, the only way to obtain the added furniture is through CJB Item Spawner. It will not appear in the Furniture Catalogue!

[size=5]Config Options:[/size]

Install the mod and run the game using SMAPI at least once in order to generate a config.json file.

- [b]Replace Wizard Furniture[/b] Replace the vanilla Wizard furniture. (True, False) Defaults False
- [b]Add New Furniture[/b]: Instead of replacing the vanilla Wizard furniture, this option adds new. The catalogue is available for purchase from Krobus if you have Misc Map Actions Properties installed. (True, False) Defaults True
- [b]Catalogue Set Price[/b]: Adjust the price of the Goth Wizard Catalogue in Krobus' shop. Defaults 150,000

[size=5]Install:[/size]

- Download and install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] (and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url] if you want the catalogue).
- Copy [CP] Jen's Goth Wizard Furniture into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
- Load the game using SMAPI and enjoy!
